metadata.title: Service Bus and ESB

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for centralized integration, orchestration, and mediation of system-to-system messaging.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Enterprise service buses, integration hubs, orchestration engines, message routers, and protocol mediation layers.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Pattern for governing centralized orchestration, transformation, and policy enforcement in integration architectures.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Service bus trust assumes baseline integration identity, ownership, boundary control, and accountability.

metadata.remarks: Service Bus and ESB defines trust properties required when integration logic is centralized. This pattern addresses invisible routing logic, semantic transformation risk, privilege concentration, and governance blind spots inherent in ESB-style architectures.

components.title: Centralized Routing and Orchestration Control
components.description: Ensures routing and orchestration logic is explicit, authorized, and observable.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Manipulation of routing or orchestration logic to alter system behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Access control restricting who may define orchestration behavior.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Enforcement mechanisms restrict modification of routing and orchestration logic.
Policies define approved use of centralized routing and orchestration.

components.title: Message Transformation and Semantic Integrity
components.description: Prevents unintended semantic changes during message transformation or mediation.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Injection of malformed or semantically altered messages through mediation layers.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Validation of transformed messages against authoritative contracts.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Integrity mechanisms ensure message transformations do not violate contracts.

components.title: Privilege Concentration and Scope Reduction
components.description: Limits accumulated authority and blast radius of centralized integration components.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of trusted integration hubs to access multiple downstream systems.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Identity and privilege isolation for centralized integration components.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Centralized integration components operate under least privilege.

components.title: Service Bus Observability and Auditability
components.description: Provides visibility into routing decisions, transformations, and policy enforcement.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Suppression of evidence related to orchestration or mediation behavior.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Audit logging and full traceability of integration decisions.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Service bus routing and transformation activities are logged.
Audit review supports investigation of integration-layer behavior.
